academic_terms: invariant of a closed economic system

dascp.note: Establishes the system-wide accounting invariant (V conserved by internal ops, updated correctly by sanctioned flows); does not fix the private/public accounting model C25-S requires.
Provides the accounting invariant that distinguishes sanctioned flows from internal moves; does not establish the customer-vs-proprietary account delineation C26-S mandates.
Within-ledger conservation invariant; cross-ledger inventory consistency is the generalization not yet covered (tracked as a gap).

iso20022.note: Settlement transaction instructions move value within the system; the property's conservation invariant V' = V + d - w + m - b constrains every sese.023 leg's accounting effect to one of the sanctioned-flow terms (no value creation ex nihilo).
The SettlementAmount element carries the value being settled; the property's per-asset value measure V projects onto this element per leg.

descriptions.semantic: The total accounted value held by a system (across all balances, pools, vaults, and obligations, measured in a canonical accounting unit) changes only through explicitly sanctioned flows — authorized issuance/burn and external deposit/withdrawal — and is otherwise conserved. No internal operation creates or destroys value; in particular liabilities never silently exceed assets.
descriptions.system_theoretic: A conservation law on the system's value measure V: State → ℝ≥0 (or a per-asset vector): V is invariant under all internal transitions and changes by exactly the signed external/issuance flow under sanctioned ones. Solvency (assets ≥ liabilities) is a refinement of this law restricted to the claims structure.
descriptions.security: The economic root invariant from which most DeFi safety descends. Its violation is value leakage or fabrication: inflation (no-unauthorized-mint failure, BPO:0001), rounding drains, share-price manipulation (donation/inflation attacks), reentrancy double-spend (BPO:0020), and oracle-induced phantom value. A protocol that conserves value cannot be drained by accounting alone.
descriptions.execution_semantics: Concretely tracked as relations like totalSupply == Σ balances, vault.totalAssets == Σ user claims (modulo fees), reserves == backing. Violations live in: rounding that does not conserve, fee accounting that mints unbacked shares, mints/burns not reflected in the measure, and cross-pool flows that drop a term.
descriptions.formal_verification: A 1-safety state invariant, SMT/Certora-checkable: prove V is preserved by every internal transition and updated correctly by sanctioned flows. Solvency adds the inequality assets ≥ liabilities as a strengthened invariant. Rounding requires interval/abstract-interpretation reasoning to bound directionality (round in the protocol's favor).

formalization.signature: Value measure V: State → ℝ≥0 (per-asset: Vector). Sanctioned flows: deposit d, withdraw w, mint m, burn b. Internal ⊆ Op (everything else).
formalization.first_order_logic:
Internal conservation:  ∀ s,s',o . ( o ∈ Internal ∧ s --[o]--> s' ) → V(s') = V(s).
Sanctioned update:  ∀ s,s' . s --[flow]--> s' → V(s') = V(s) + d − w + m − b.
Solvency (refinement):  ∀ reachable s . assets(s) ≥ liabilities(s).

temporal_logic.ltl: G( V == externalNetInflow + initialValue )   ∧   G( assets ≥ liabilities )

formalization.state_machine: Annotate each transition with its value delta; the property is that internal transitions carry delta 0 and sanctioned ones carry exactly their declared signed flow; solvency is the reachable-state predicate assets ≥ liabilities.
formalization.type_theoretic: Value as a conserved linear resource: internal operations are typed as resource-preserving rearrangements (no creation/destruction), sanctioned flows consume/produce an explicit external-flow witness.
formalization.algebraic: (Value, +) commutative monoid (or module per-asset); V is the monoid fold over holdings; internal transitions are automorphisms preserving the fold.

bindings.note: Partial: V is the per-asset value measure (State → ℝ≥0 per asset); ISO 20022's SettlementAmount carries the monetary value of a settlement leg per asset and currency. V projects onto SettlementAmount per leg; the conservation invariant V' = V + d − w + m − b constrains how SettlementAmount-aggregated values change across sanctioned flows.

relationships.note: No-unauthorized-mint is the issuance leg of conservation (the m term is gated).
Lending ledger consistency specializes the accounting invariant to pooled lending, naming the position map, aggregation operator and backing relation that generic conservation leaves undefined.
Directed conversion safety bounds the DIRECTION of the rounding residual; conservation bounds only its total. Neither implies the other.
Accrual supplies the sanctioned value-creating term, and bounds the fee by what was actually generated.
Liquidation supplies the loss-allocation term: a recognized loss is a sanctioned reduction rather than a conservation violation only when applied to both sides of the backing relation.
Reentrancy is a principal mechanism that breaks conservation via double-spend.
Sanctioned flows (mint/burn/admin sweeps) must be access-controlled.

attack_surface.pattern: unbacked supply increase (BPO:0001 failure) breaks assets=liabilities
first-depositor / donation attack manipulates share price so later deposits round to zero shares
attack_surface.notes: Virtual shares/assets offset; round in protocol favor.

attack_surface.pattern: rounding direction lets repeated ops siphon dust until material
attack_surface.notes: Always round against the user / in the protocol's favor; bound cumulative error.

attack_surface.pattern: fee logic mints shares not backed by assets
attack_surface.notes: Conservation must include the fee term explicitly.

attack_surface.pattern: manipulated price inflates measured value, enabling over-borrow
attack_surface.notes: Solvency refinement depends on oracle integrity (future BPO node).

metrics: V drift between consecutive states (internal ops: 0)

strategies.notes: Prove V preserved by internal ops and updated correctly by flows; prove assets ≥ liabilities inductively.
Stateful handlers with random flows; assert conservation/solvency invariants.
Bound cumulative rounding and prove it cannot be drained.

testability: random op sequences preserve V and solvency
donation/first-depositor attack cannot mint free shares

static: fee/flow terms explicit in the accounting model

assumptions.statement: Checked arithmetic so the value measure cannot wrap.
Price/oracle inputs to the value measure are accurate (for the solvency refinement).

provenance.notes: Economic root; parent (via refinedBy) of BPO:0001 and of future solvency/collateralization/liquidation/reserve-consistency children.
